name: Ancient Academy
description: Private school, a scene in a small street of Tang Dynasty, shaded by green bamboos, with the sound of books, elegant and solemn. There are tens of thousands of books here, there are many peaches and plums all over the world, and many pillars of the country have been cultivated. Every time I pass by, I can see students studying hard through the windows. The walls of the private school are painted with pines and green bamboos, and Chinese elements such as calligraphy and fans are integrated into it, making it particularly elegant. Let’s learn together, ask questions and debate, let us feel the humanistic style of the Tang Dynasty in the fragrance of books!
